script: Tens of thousands of pieces of space junk circle Earth. They include old satellites, rocket parts and tiny flecks of paint. Many travel at about 28,000 kilometers per hour. At that speed, even a paint fleck can chip a space station window. The station sometimes moves out of the way to dodge debris. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
title: A Paint Fleck Can Chip the Space Station #SpaceJunk #SpaceFacts #Shorts
